datado.afirma: Link wraps an <a> child (and the custom Link clones the child).

release.afirma: Link always renders <a>; an <a> child is no longer allowed (legacyBehavior or remove; new-link codemod).

conflitos.nota: For Next >= 13 the NXHB pattern breaks; the custom Link with cloneElement (p.54) depends on the child.

datado.afirma: next export generates a fully static site.

release.afirma: next export command removed in favor of output: 'export'.

conflitos.nota: NXHB mentions the command only as a feature in the list (p.6).

datado.afirma: package.json with next ^9.1.2, react ^16.11.0; tells you to use the latest Node LTS (no number).

release.afirma: Minimum React 18.2.0 (was 17.0.2); minimum Node 14.6.0. Later: Node 18.17 (NX14), 18.18.0 (NX15), 20.9.0 (NX16).

conflitos.nota: The NXHB project (React 16) does not meet the Next 13+ minimum according to NX13 p.14.

datado.afirma: npx create-next-app (without @latest); structure with pages/; dev scripts: next, build, start.

release.afirma: npx create-next-app@latest; redesigned template with App Router by default, TypeScript, Tailwind and ESLint.

conflitos.nota: The releases use next dev/next build (NX13 p.8; NX16 p.6); they do not say that bare 'next' without a subcommand was removed (silence).

release.afirma: app/ in beta (not recommended for production); pages/ stable and supported 'for the foreseeable future'; incremental adoption.

conflitos.nota: NX15 p.5-6, 18 keeps the Pages Router (with React 18/19); NX16 p.7 makes the App Router the create-next-app default; NX16 does NOT say whether the Pages Router is still supported or deprecated (NO information).

datado.afirma: getInitialProps in the page component; runs on the server and on client navigation.

release.afirma: Async Server Components + extended fetch (cache force-cache/no-store/revalidate), compared with getStaticProps/getServerSideProps.

conflitos.nota: No release mentions getInitialProps or declares it deprecated; they are different models (Pages vs app/). Do not claim deprecation.

datado.afirma: pages/api with export default (req, res); req.method, req.query, cookies, body.

release.afirma: API Routes (since Next 9) vs Server Actions: a 'use server' function called from the component without creating a manual API Route.

conflitos.nota: NX14 does not say API Routes were removed. NX15 p.4 covers GET Route Handlers (App Router).

release.afirma: metadata API (with viewport/generateViewport); NX15 mentions generateMetadata (p.3).

conflitos.nota: The releases do not say whether next/head was deprecated.

datado.afirma: Prefetch when the Link enters the viewport, production only; Save-Data/slow connection; prefetch={false}.

release.afirma: Rewritten prefetch cache: layout deduplication and incremental prefetch (cancels outside the viewport).

conflitos.nota: NX13 p.14: no prefetch for bots; NX15 p.12: <Form> with prefetch.

datado.afirma: Next abstracts webpack; @next/bundle-analyzer + cross-env ANALYZE=true next build.

release.afirma: Turbopack is the default (dev and build); webpack via next dev/build --webpack.

conflitos.nota: The releases say nothing about @next/bundle-analyzer under Turbopack (silence).

datado.afirma: styled-jsx; external CSS via @zeit/next-css; Sass via @zeit/next-sass.

release.afirma: Only mentions merging global CSS with CSS Modules (improvement item); NX16 p.7: template with Tailwind CSS.

datado.afirma: Next.js created by Zeit; deploy with the now CLI (now.sh).

release.afirma: The releases mention the Vercel core team (NX14 p.10; NX15 p.19) and the footer 'Vercel, Inc.'.

conflitos.nota: The texts do not relate Zeit and Vercel. [extrapolation] they are the same company renamed; this is not in the collection. Now plan prices/limits (NXHB p.77) are [DATED].

datado.afirma: Dynamic import() inside getInitialProps to split Moment.js into another bundle.

release.afirma: next/dynamic: suspense prop removed; ssr:false disallowed in Server Components.

conflitos.nota: NXHB does not use next/dynamic in its examples; only dynamic import().

datado.afirma: 'Prerendered Page' icon (automatic static optimization) when the page has no getInitialProps.

release.afirma: Static Route Indicator in dev and per-route strategy in the next build output.

conflitos.nota: Close concepts, different mechanisms (Pages vs App Router); NX15 does not mention the NXHB icon.

conflitos.tema: React: creation tool and rendering in RCTHB

release.afirma: Minimum React 18.2.0; NX15 p.5-6: React 19 RC in the App Router; NX16 p.11: React 19.2.

conflitos.nota: The releases do not mention create-react-app or ReactDOM.render. Whether these patterns work in React 18/19 is [extrapolation], outside the collection.

datado.afirma: Components with useState, onClick and useEffect (client model), with no server/client distinction.

release.afirma: app/ adopts React Server Components; server-first by default.

conflitos.nota: RCTHB does not cover Server Components; the collection does not detail the 'use client' boundary beyond mentions (NX14 p.4 uses 'use server').

release.afirma: eslint-plugin-react-hooks 5.0.0 with new rules (the text does not describe them); NX14 p.5 mentions useOptimistic/useFormState/useFormStatus; NX16 p.11 mentions useEffectEvent.

conflitos.nota: New hooks are only mentioned in the releases; no usage explanation in the collection.
